source_selection: 3 real people; fixed or nearly fixed original camera, simple background, large half-body subject, slow small-range motion
stage3_a_image: actual native final frame of selected Stage2 output, supplied as Stage3 initial-frame image plus appearance conditioning where supported
stage3_a_video: real source motion segment including t* as frame0 and following frames in order
route_b: generate new-view Stage3 from real source segment first; use its actual native frame0 as future Stage2 terminal constraint, source t* as Stage2 initial constraint
stage2_input_first_frame: actual Stage1 final frame at t*; must be consumed as Stage2 initial-frame condition
stage3_input_first_frame: actual selected Stage2 native final decoded frame; must be consumed as Stage3 initial-frame condition, not merely an appearance reference
stage3_motion_input: entire corresponding source Stage3 segment including t* frame0 through defined source end; no silent81-frame truncation
first_frame_effectiveness: independently compare original native generated f0 against actual effective first-frame image and inspect pose,identity,viewpoint,scene; input argument presence alone is insufficient
